**[P2] Preserve earlier invocation boundaries in terminal roots**

A fresh wall-clock anchor is captured on every resume, while reset discards the previous boundary. If wall time moves backward between invocations handled by the same plugin instance, the terminal `Workflow` and `DurableExecutionRoot` end before the earlier `Invocation`; the new negative-wall-step case omits that containment assertion. Retain a per-execution high-water mark across invocation resets and clamp terminal root completion to it for warm resumes, then assert containment when `freshPlugin` is false while keeping the documented cross-container limitation.
